title: Drag and Drop App from icon task bar in desired Activity not working (move to activity or copy to activity)
line: Dropping a task manager entry on an activity in the Activity Manager sidebar now moves the window there or also shows it there.
explanation: The Activity Manager sidebar shows Move to this activity and Show also in this activity drop zones when a task is dragged onto it, but SwitcherBackend::drop() only closed drop mode. The code that changed the window's activities only existed for X11 and was removed with the X11 bits, so on Wayland nothing ever happened. The drop handler now reads the window ids from the drag, finds those windows in a WindowTasksModel and calls requestActivities(), replacing the current activity (move) or adding the target one (copy), the same way the pager does.

commits.message:
imports/activitymanager: move and copy windows dropped on activities

Dropping a task onto Move to this activity or Show also in this activity
in the Activity Manager sidebar did nothing on Wayland, as the code was
X11-only and got removed. Do it through the task model on Wayland too.
